challenge: Labs are tomorrow at 9:20 AM, so today is a light day: hard lifting can bump muscle and liver enzymes on a blood draw. New Buffalo is dry and calm again, about 39°F now and around 62°F from 1 to 5 PM with light wind (2 to 8 mph). Do an easy early-afternoon paddle or a brisk walk, then a short set of easy pushups and some mobility. Nothing to failure. WHOOP was signed out on my computer this morning, so go by feel.
constraint: Labs eve: keep it light and skip anything heavy or to failure until after tomorrow's 9:20 AM draw.
items: Easy kayak 30 min OR brisk 30–40 min walk (early afternoon, ~62°F, light wind)
Pushups: 2 x 10, easy, well short of failure
10 min mobility and stretching (hips, hamstrings, shoulders)
Total Gym light upper, 2 x 12 rows at low incline (optional)
